blocks.html: Robinsons Homes opened its new sales office at the 3rd floor of Robinsons Place Bacolod. The office blessing was graced by (L-R) Bacolod City councilor Honorable Wilson Gamboa, Brand Ambassadress Maja Salvador, Business Unit General Manager Ms. Cora Ang Ley, Vice Mayor Honorable Greg Gasataya, and councilor Honorable Ana Marie Palermo.
